cohort: The study included 945 mother-baby dyads, where mothers had children aged from two to three years in the community.
finding: The study found an early-initiation rate of breastfeeding of 76%, an exclusive breastfeeding rate of 71%, and a continuation of lactation till two years and beyond of 77.78%.
mod_finding: Early initiation of breastfeeding within the first hour was 65% for normal delivery and 48% for Caesarean section.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from mothers when their children were aged between two and three years.
